question: Which of the following SAARC Centre is established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SAARC Disaster Management Centre(SDMC)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The SAARC Documentation Centre (SDC) and the SAARC Disaster Management Centre (SDMC) Interim Unit (IU) are both SAARC centres established in India
 
• SAARC Documentation Centre (SDC)
 
 
• Established in 1994 in New Delhi, India, the SDC is affiliated with SAARC. Some say it's a leading institute for scientific popularization in India.
 
 
 
• SAARC Disaster Management Centre (SDMC) Interim Unit (IU)
 
• Established in November 2016 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, the SDMC IU is located under the Gujarat Institute of Disaster Management (GIDM).
 
• The SDMC's mandate is to support member states in reducing disaster risk. Its activities include: 
 
 
• Applying science and technology 
 
• Exchanging best practices 
 
• Developing capacity 
 
• Conducting collaborative research 
 
• Networking 
 
• Coordinating national tuberculosis programs 
 
• Exchanging information and research 
 
• Implementing activities 
 
• Collecting, analyzing, and disseminating information
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• SAARC Energy Centre (SEC) in Islamabad, Pakistan:
 
 
• Established: 2006
 
• 
 
It is mandated to promote energy cooperation among SAARC member states, including the development of hydropower, renewable energy, and energy efficiency

 
 
 
 
• SAARC Cultural Centre (SCC) in Colombo, Sri Lanka:
 
 
• Established: 1985
 
• It is mandated to promote cultural exchange and cooperation among SAARC member states, including organizing festivals, exhibitions, and workshops, and promoting the arts, literature, and music of the region
 
 
 
• SAARC Agriculture Centre (SAC) in Dhaka, Bangladesh
 
 
• Established: 1989
 
• It is mandated to promote agricultural cooperation among SAARC member states, including sharing knowledge and technology and improving agricultural productivity and sustainability
